status_at_specification: No diagnostic model outputs have been produced; primary checkpoint already locked.
purpose: Distinguish success on the four trained policies from following a new stated temporal rule.
input_view: External clock features with explicit new rule text and raw times; no training rule text is appended.

conditions.novel_inverted: Alert iff elapsed < threshold; wait at equality or above.
conditions.novel_window: Alert iff lower <= elapsed <= upper; wait outside, balancing lower and upper crossings.
conditions.novel_familiar_control: Alert iff elapsed >= threshold. Same states, choices, order and sentence structure as inverted cases, with only the comparison phrase and labels changed. Explicit parent IDs connect cases.

primary_diagnostic_metric: Both members of each counterfactual pair correct, by rule; item accuracy also reported.
interpretation: If familiar control succeeds and novel rules fail, scope the adapter to the trained policies rather than instruction-conditioned temporal reasoning. Even success establishes only these synthetic rules, not broad real-time understanding.
selection_policy: Diagnostic only: no retraining, checkpoint replacement or threshold tuning based on these outputs. Primary held-out protocol remains unchanged.
